اعتنقا (form VIII)

# اُعْتُنِقَا (uʕtuniqā) /uʕ.tu.ni.qaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
# اِعْتَنِقَا (iʕtaniqā) /iʕ.ta.ni.qaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِعْتَنَقَ (iʕtanaqa)
